strings.zh: 你好啊年轻人,欢迎来到水都图书馆,{NEWLINE}我是这里的馆长本葛雷。{SCROLL}我们馆里收藏了不少{NEWLINE}关于口袋妖怪传说的书籍,{CLEAR}如果你也对传说中的精灵们感兴趣,{CLEAR}本馆的藏书一定能让你满意。
strings.en: Hello there, young one. Welcome to the{NEWLINE}Alto Mare Library. I’m Lorenzo, the{CLEAR}director here.{SCROLL}Our library holds many books about{NEWLINE}Pokémon legends. If you’re interested{CLEAR}in legendary Pokémon too, our{CLEAR}collection is sure to satisfy you.
strings.notes: Alto Mare Library (One Island); director Lorenzo, Bianca's grandfather.

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎光临水都图书馆。{NEWLINE}目前本图书馆正在举办{CLEAR}关于精灵传说的有奖问答活动,{CLEAR}如果您能答对我提出的全部问题,{CLEAR}将会获得丰厚的奖品。{CLEAR}请问您要参加吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Library. The library is currently{CLEAR}holding a prize quiz on Pokémon legends.{CLEAR}If you can answer all my questions{CLEAR}correctly, you’ll win a generous prize.{CLEAR}Would you like to take part?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 好的,下面请听第一题：{NEWLINE}根据水都群岛的传说,{CLEAR}拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯是什么关系？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Very well. Here is the first question:{NEWLINE}According to the legends of the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands, how are Latios and{CLEAR}Latias related?{SCROLL}

strings.en: Now the fourth question: According to{NEWLINE}the legend, how should people{CLEAR}summon Arceus?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭喜你答对了全部问题,{NEWLINE}看来你对水都群岛的各种传说故事{CLEAR}都相当了解嘛。{SCROLL}这个是本次活动的奖品,请收下吧。
strings.en: Congratulations, you answered every{NEWLINE}question correctly! You seem to know{CLEAR}the legends of the Alto Mare Islands{CLEAR}very well.{SCROLL}Here is the prize for this event. Please{NEWLINE}accept it.

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎光临水都图书馆。{NEWLINE}请您时刻注意在图书馆内保持安静,{CLEAR}不要影响到其他人。
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Library. Please be sure to keep quiet in{CLEAR}the library so you don’t{CLEAR}disturb others.

strings.zh: 很遗憾您没有回答对全部问题。{NEWLINE}您可以在图书馆的书籍中{CLEAR}寻找一下答案再来回答。
strings.en: I’m sorry, but you didn’t answer every{NEWLINE}question correctly. You can search the{CLEAR}library’s books for the answers and{CLEAR}try again.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「水都兄妹传」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘The Alto{NEWLINE}Mare Siblings.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 很久很久以前,一之岛上{NEWLINE}住着一个老公公和一个老婆婆{SCROLL}有一天,他们两人在海边{NEWLINE}救回了一对受伤的兄妹。{CLEAR}在老公公跟老婆婆细心的看护下,{CLEAR}两个人所受的伤慢慢的痊愈了。{SCROLL}但是不久后一群强盗{NEWLINE}来到水都群岛烧杀抢劫,{CLEAR}就在群岛陷入危机的时候,{CLEAR}在老公公和老婆婆的面前,{CLEAR}小兄妹的样子发生了变化,{CLEAR}原来他们是幻之口袋妖怪——{CLEAR}拉帝欧斯与拉帝亚斯。{SCROLL}这两只口袋妖怪呼唤了许多{NEWLINE}强力的同伴赶来助阵,{CLEAR}最终击退了无恶不作的强盗。{SCROLL}从那之后拉帝欧斯与拉帝亚斯{NEWLINE}就成为了水都的守护神,{CLEAR}一直在暗中默默地守护着群岛的居民。
strings.en: Long, long ago, an old man and an old{NEWLINE}woman lived on One Island.{SCROLL}One day, the two of them rescued an{NEWLINE}injured brother and sister on the{CLEAR}beach. Under the old couple’s loving{CLEAR}care, the siblings’ wounds{CLEAR}slowly healed.{SCROLL}But not long after, a band of bandits{NEWLINE}came to the Alto Mare Islands, burning,{CLEAR}killing and looting. Just as the islands{CLEAR}fell into peril, the siblings changed{CLEAR}form before the old couple’s eyes. They{CLEAR}were the Mythical Pokémon Latios{CLEAR}and Latias!{SCROLL}The two Pokémon called many powerful{NEWLINE}allies to their aid, and in the end they{CLEAR}drove off the wicked bandits.{SCROLL}From then on, Latios and Latias became{NEWLINE}the guardian deities of Alto Mare,{CLEAR}quietly protecting the islanders from{CLEAR}the shadows.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「天空之龙」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘Dragon of{NEWLINE}the Sky.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说很久以前,{NEWLINE}有一个农夫从地理刨出了{CLEAR}一颗发出绿色光芒的神奇珠子。{CLEAR}正所谓匹夫无罪、怀壁其罪,{CLEAR}这颗宝珠引来了无数商人的巧取豪夺。{CLEAR}农夫为了保护自己的珠子不被抢走,{CLEAR}就把珠子带到了四之岛上的天柱峰,{CLEAR}准备藏到这个人迹罕至的地方。{SCROLL}这时候神奇的事情发生了,{NEWLINE}一只巨大的绿色蛇形口袋妖怪{CLEAR}从天而降带走了宝珠。{CLEAR}自此绿色宝珠和那只绿色精灵{CLEAR}就再也没有出现过。{SCROLL}后来人们根据农夫的口述,{NEWLINE}把绿色的口袋妖怪画了下来,{CLEAR}并为它取名烈空坐。{SCROLL}书的最后是烈空坐的画像。
strings.en: Legend says that long ago, a farmer dug{NEWLINE}a mysterious orb glowing with green{CLEAR}light out of the ground. As the saying{CLEAR}goes, the common man is guilty of{CLEAR}nothing but owning a treasure. The orb{CLEAR}drew countless merchants trying to{CLEAR}cheat or seize it from him.{SCROLL}To keep his orb from being taken, the{NEWLINE}farmer carried it to Sky Pillar Peak on{CLEAR}Four Island, meaning to hide it in that{CLEAR}remote, lonely place.{SCROLL}Then something miraculous happened. A{NEWLINE}huge, green, serpent-like Pokémon came{CLEAR}down from the sky and carried the orb{CLEAR}away. Neither the Jade Orb nor the{CLEAR}green Pokémon was ever seen again.{SCROLL}Later, from the farmer’s account,{NEWLINE}people drew a picture of the green{CLEAR}Pokémon and named it Rayquaza.{SCROLL}At the end of the book is a portrait{NEWLINE}of Rayquaza.
strings.notes: zh 地理 read as 地里 (from the ground); 怀壁 as 怀璧.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「灼热的精灵」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘The{NEWLINE}Scorching Pokémon.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说席多蓝恩是身披熔岩的口袋妖怪,{NEWLINE}它与水都兄妹一起{CLEAR}驱赶了侵略群岛的强盗。{SCROLL}战争结束后,席多蓝恩去营救{NEWLINE}被困在废虚中的人们,{CLEAR}却因为自身温度太高{CLEAR}烫伤了被救的孩子。{SCROLL}自责的席多蓝恩离开了水都群岛,{NEWLINE}躲到了某个湿冷的洞穴之后{CLEAR}就再也没有现身过。
strings.en: Legend says Heatran is a Pokémon clad{NEWLINE}in lava. Together with the Alto Mare{CLEAR}siblings, it drove off the bandits who{CLEAR}invaded the islands.{SCROLL}After the war, Heatran went to rescue{NEWLINE}people trapped in the ruins. But its{CLEAR}body was so hot that it burned a child{CLEAR}it had saved.{SCROLL}Blaming itself, Heatran left the Alto{NEWLINE}Mare Islands. It hid away in some damp,{CLEAR}cold cave and was never seen again.
strings.notes: zh 废虚 read as 废墟 (ruins).

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「神柱之王」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘King of{NEWLINE}the Pillars.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说圣柱王在关东大陆{NEWLINE}制造了岩、冰、钢三个分身,{CLEAR}帮助那里的人们抵抗入侵的强盗。{CLEAR}而当水都群岛遭到强盗袭击的时候,{CLEAR}圣柱王回应水都兄妹的呼唤,{CLEAR}亲自来到了这里,{CLEAR}将入侵者尽数驱赶。{SCROLL}人们为了纪念圣柱王,便将它的形象{NEWLINE}刻到了七之岛祭祀祠堂的墙壁上。
strings.en: Legend says Regigigas made three clones{NEWLINE}of rock, ice and steel in the Kanto{CLEAR}region to help the people there fight{CLEAR}off invading bandits. When bandits{CLEAR}attacked the Alto Mare Islands,{CLEAR}Regigigas answered the call of the Alto{CLEAR}Mare siblings, came here in person, and{CLEAR}drove out every last invader.{SCROLL}To honor Regigigas, people carved its{NEWLINE}image into the walls of the Ritual Shrine{CLEAR}on Seven Island.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「梦幻岛」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘Dream{NEWLINE}Island.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 五之岛是一座{NEWLINE}能同时展现四季的梦幻小岛,{CLEAR}上面栖息的精灵也极为特殊,{CLEAR}据说拥有全部精灵基因的……{CLEAR}后面的几页被撕掉了。{SCROLL}书末的借阅卡上写着：富士。
strings.en: Five Island is a dreamlike little island{NEWLINE}that shows all four seasons at once.{CLEAR}The Pokémon that live there are also{CLEAR}very special. It is said that the one{CLEAR}possessing the genes of every{CLEAR}Pokémon... The next few pages have{CLEAR}been torn out.{SCROLL}The library card at the back of the{NEWLINE}book reads: Fuji.
strings.notes: | RV004: addition: zh breaks off mid-sentence (torn pages); English no longer completes it

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「天外来客」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘Visitor{NEWLINE}from Beyond the Sky.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 50年前一颗流星从天而降,{NEWLINE}重重地砸在了六之岛上。{CLEAR}后来人们跑去查看,{CLEAR}发现这颗流星其实是{CLEAR}一个尖锐的三棱锥,{CLEAR}这个三棱锥会时不时地自己移动,{CLEAR}仿佛是有生命一般。{CLEAR}但它究竟是什么,至今仍是个迷。
strings.en: Fifty years ago, a meteor fell from the{NEWLINE}sky and slammed into Six Island. When{CLEAR}people went to look, they found the{CLEAR}meteor was really a sharp, three-sided{CLEAR}pyramid. The pyramid moved on its own{CLEAR}from time to time, as if it were alive.{CLEAR}But what it really is remains a mystery{CLEAR}to this day.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「许愿之星」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘The{NEWLINE}Wishing Star.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说1000年苏醒一次的{NEWLINE}口袋妖怪基拉祈,{CLEAR}拥有可以实现任何愿望的能力。{CLEAR}但基拉祈出现的方式一直莫衷一是。{CLEAR}有人说六之岛上的三棱锥{CLEAR}就是基拉祈沉睡的样子,{CLEAR}有人却说基拉祈沉睡在海底……
strings.en: Legend says the Pokémon Jirachi, which{NEWLINE}wakes once every 1,000 years, has the{CLEAR}power to grant any wish. But no one{CLEAR}agrees on how Jirachi appears. Some say{CLEAR}the pyramid on Six Island is Jirachi in{CLEAR}its slumber. Others say Jirachi sleeps{CLEAR}at the bottom of the sea...

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「苍海的王子」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘Prince of{NEWLINE}the Sea.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 传说古时候有一名渔夫,{NEWLINE}捡到了一颗口袋妖怪蛋,{CLEAR}在他的悉心照料下{CLEAR}这颗蛋孵化出了精灵玛纳菲。{SCROLL}玛纳菲为了报答渔夫的孵化之恩,{NEWLINE}就从海底为渔夫带来了很多金银财宝,{CLEAR}最终渔夫过上了富足的生活。{SCROLL}听过这个故事的人{NEWLINE}都疯狂地寻找着玛纳菲,{CLEAR}做着一夜暴富的黄梁美梦。
strings.en: Legend says that long ago, a fisherman{NEWLINE}found a Pokémon Egg. Under his careful{CLEAR}care, the Egg hatched into Manaphy.{SCROLL}To repay the fisherman for hatching it,{NEWLINE}Manaphy brought him loads of gold,{CLEAR}silver and treasure from the seabed,{CLEAR}and in the end the fisherman lived a life{CLEAR}of plenty.{SCROLL}Everyone who heard the story went wild{NEWLINE}searching for Manaphy, lost in pipe{CLEAR}dreams of getting rich overnight.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「美梦与噩梦」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘Sweet{NEWLINE}Dreams and Nightmares.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 据说很久以前有一座城市,{NEWLINE}里面的所有居民只要入睡就会做噩梦,{CLEAR}所以那里的人们{CLEAR}长期处于睡眠不足的颓废状态。{SCROLL}旅行经过此地的训练家{NEWLINE}发现了问题所在,{CLEAR}原来是因为有一只叫{CLEAR}达克莱伊的精灵栖息在这里。{CLEAR}只要是靠近这只精灵的人,{CLEAR}在睡觉时都会做起可怕的噩梦。{CLEAR}训练家收服达克莱伊后,{CLEAR}放出了自己的另一只精灵克雷色利亚,{CLEAR}城里的人们在进入梦乡后,{CLEAR}在克雷色利亚的影响下{CLEAR}全都做起了甜美的梦。
strings.en: It is said that long ago, there was a{NEWLINE}city where every resident had{CLEAR}nightmares whenever they fell asleep.{CLEAR}The people there were always worn out{CLEAR}from lack of sleep.{SCROLL}A Trainer traveling through found the{NEWLINE}cause: a Pokémon called Darkrai lived{CLEAR}there. Anyone who came near it had{CLEAR}terrible nightmares in their sleep.{CLEAR}After the Trainer caught Darkrai, they{CLEAR}sent out another of their Pokémon,{CLEAR}Cresselia. Under Cresselia’s influence,{CLEAR}everyone in the city had sweet dreams{CLEAR}once they fell asleep.

strings.zh: 书架上放着一本「天界之笛」,{NEWLINE}要读读看吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a book on the shelf: ‘The Azure{NEWLINE}Flute.’ Read it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 很久以前,有一群到处作恶的强盗,{NEWLINE}用他们偶然偷来的「天界之笛」{CLEAR}召唤出了传说中的口袋妖怪阿尔宙斯。{SCROLL}根据神奥地区的传说,{NEWLINE}阿尔宙斯是一只形似麒麟的口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}因为它拥有全部的属性,{CLEAR}所以被人们认为是世界的创造者。{SCROLL}强盗们用尽办法收服阿尔宙斯后,{NEWLINE}便驱使它帮助自己四处抢劫,{CLEAR}最终在水都群岛的战斗中,{CLEAR}水都居民在拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯{CLEAR}以及众多精灵的帮助下,{CLEAR}从强盗手下解放了阿尔宙斯{CLEAR}并赶走了强盗。{SCROLL}被解救的阿尔宙斯为了感谢水都居民,{NEWLINE}便将召唤它的道具「天界之笛」{CLEAR}藏在了水都群岛。{CLEAR}据说只要让白银山的大雪{CLEAR}飘落到水都群岛,{CLEAR}就能让天界之笛重见天日。
strings.en: Long ago, a band of wicked bandits used{NEWLINE}the Azure Flute they had stolen by{CLEAR}chance to summon the legendary{CLEAR}Pokémon Arceus.{SCROLL}According to Sinnoh legend, Arceus is a{NEWLINE}Pokémon shaped like a qilin. Because it{CLEAR}has every type, people believe it{CLEAR}created the world.{SCROLL}After the bandits caught Arceus by{NEWLINE}every means they had, they forced it to{CLEAR}help them plunder far and wide. In the{CLEAR}end, in the battle of the Alto Mare{CLEAR}Islands, the people of Alto Mare,{CLEAR}helped by Latios, Latias and many other{CLEAR}Pokémon, freed Arceus from the bandits{CLEAR}and drove them away.{SCROLL}To thank the people of Alto Mare for{NEWLINE}saving it, Arceus hid the Azure Flute,{CLEAR}the item used to summon it, in the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands. They say that if the{CLEAR}heavy snow of Mt. Silver falls on the{CLEAR}Alto Mare Islands, the Azure Flute will{CLEAR}see the light of day again.

strings.zh: 我记得有本关于五之岛的书,{NEWLINE}是在哪来着……
strings.en: I remember there’s a book about Five{NEWLINE}Island. Where was it again...

strings.zh: 图书馆的书好多啊,{NEWLINE}看得我眼都花了。
strings.en: The library has so many books. My eyes{NEWLINE}are going blurry.

strings.zh: 这里的书上记载着着很多{NEWLINE}关于传说中精灵的故事。
strings.en: The books here record lots of stories{NEWLINE}about legendary Pokémon.

strings.zh: 这里书上记载的传说故事,{NEWLINE}都是群岛居民口耳相传下来的,{CLEAR}记载的内容与真实情况{CLEAR}或许已经大相径庭了也说不定。
strings.en: The legends in these books were passed{NEWLINE}down by word of mouth among the{CLEAR}islanders. What they say may be very{CLEAR}different from what really happened.

strings.zh: 等我看完了这里的传说,{NEWLINE}我就可以回去讲给同学们听了。
strings.en: Once I’ve read the legends here, I can{NEWLINE}go back and tell my classmates{CLEAR}about them.

strings.zh: 我要将传说故事中真实的部分{NEWLINE}转化为有用的情报,{CLEAR}然后卖给愿意出价的人大赚一笔。
strings.en: I’m going to turn the true parts of{NEWLINE}these legends into useful intel, then{CLEAR}sell it to anyone willing to pay and make{CLEAR}a killing.
strings.notes: | RV004: meaning: 愿意出价的人 is anyone willing to pay, not the highest bidder (D-1792)

strings.zh: 我在想书上说的这些传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}有多少是真实存在的,{CLEAR}又有多少是人们想象出来的呢。
strings.en: I wonder how many of the legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon in these books really exist,{CLEAR}and how many people just made up.

strings.zh: 卡侬『你好啊训练家,{NEWLINE}我是一之岛岛主本葛雷的孙女卡侬。{CLEAR}你是来找爷爷参加诸岛巡礼挑战的吧？{CLEAR}爷爷他现在有事出去了{CLEAR}过会儿才能回来。{CLEAR}你如果不着急的话{CLEAR}可以先在一之岛逛逛。
strings.en: Bianca: Hello, Trainer. I’m Bianca,{NEWLINE}granddaughter of Lorenzo, the chief of{CLEAR}One Island. You’re here to see Grandpa{CLEAR}for the Island Pilgrimage challenge,{CLEAR}right? Grandpa’s out on business right{CLEAR}now and won’t be back for a while. If{CLEAR}you’re not in a hurry, why not look{CLEAR}around One Island first?
strings.notes: Bianca here (and #58) may be Latias in disguise (see 0379).

strings.zh: 卡侬『你为什么很疑惑地看着我啊,{NEWLINE}我脸上有什么奇怪的地方吗……
strings.en: Bianca: Why are you looking at me so{NEWLINE}puzzled? Is there something odd about{CLEAR}my face...?

strings.zh: 图图犬『Smeee——gle！
strings.en: Smeargle: Smeee-gle!

strings.zh: 您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}吧？{SCROLL}欢迎冠军大人光临水都图书馆,{NEWLINE}我是这里的馆长本葛雷。{CLEAR}我们馆里收藏了不少{CLEAR}关于口袋妖怪传说的书籍,{CLEAR}如果您也对传说中的精灵们感兴趣,{CLEAR}本馆的藏书一定能让您满意。
strings.en: You’re League Champion {VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}aren’t you?{SCROLL}Welcome to the Alto Mare Library,{NEWLINE}Champion. I’m Lorenzo, the director{CLEAR}here. Our library holds many books{CLEAR}about Pokémon legends. If you’re{CLEAR}interested in legendary Pokémon too,{CLEAR}our collection is sure to satisfy you.

strings.zh: 愿拉帝欧斯和拉帝亚斯{NEWLINE}能永远陪伴您守护这片土地。
strings.en: May Latios and Latias stay by your side{NEWLINE}forever as you protect this land.

strings.zh: 您帮忙赶跑来犯的火箭队,{NEWLINE}就算是通过一之岛的巡礼考验了,{CLEAR}请继续接下来的巡礼吧。
strings.en: You drove off the invading Team Rocket,{NEWLINE}so consider the One Island Pilgrimage{CLEAR}trial passed. Please continue with the{CLEAR}rest of the pilgrimage.
